about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the chilling universe of The Stare with this official collection of atmospheric tracks that accompany your descent into paranoia.

Composed specifically to amplify the game’s tension, isolation, and mystery, this soundtrack is an immersive experience on its own. Each track is crafted to evoke a persistent sense of unease—as if something, or someone, is watching you.

From tense silences to bursts of distorted sound, this brief yet intense collection captures the essence of The Stare’s psychological horror. The game’s soundtrack includes the following tracks:

  • Static Presence

  • Footsteps in the Ceiling

  • Locked In

  • Behind the Curtain

  • Don't Look Back

  • Still Watching

Get all the tracks now to experience The Stare through its haunting music.
